claim: Adaptive turn allocation in multi-agent discussions reduces inference cost and maintains or improves novelty compared to fixed turn allocation, especially in larger teams.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing cost and novelty metrics between adaptive and fixed turn allocation strategies across different team sizes.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, team sizes, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Adaptive turn allocation compared for inference cost and novelty
